gaps.missing: NOAA/IPCC gridded regional relative sea-level scenarios joined to U.S. tide gauges, vertical land motion, and extreme-water-level thresholds.
gaps.reason: Global mean sea level cannot answer local inundation questions.
next_source_targets: NOAA 2022 U.S. Sea Level Rise Technical Report

gaps.missing: Event-specific attribution database with methods, event definition, counterfactual, risk ratio, intensity change, uncertainty, and peer-review status.
gaps.reason: General climate relationships cannot attribute an individual hurricane, flood, drought, or heat wave.

gaps.missing: Taxon- and ecosystem-specific geospatial exposure, observed abundance/range trends, attribution fields, protected areas, and land-use layers.
gaps.reason: Global risk ranges are not locally actionable and are not observed extinctions.

gaps.missing: Consistent gridded crop-model ensemble covering yield, CO2 fertilization, irrigation, adaptation, heat stress, pests, trade, prices, and nutrition under common SSP/RCP pairs.
gaps.reason: Crop sensitivity alone is not food security.

gaps.missing: Basin-scale runoff, recharge, snowpack, glacier contribution, withdrawals, consumption, environmental flows, quality, reservoirs, and drought/flood metrics under harmonized scenarios.
gaps.reason: Global exposure figures cannot explain where, when, or why water reliability changes.

gaps.missing: Consistent event-level displacement flows, repeated displacement, duration, return, destination, exposure denominators, and anthropogenic event-attribution links.
gaps.reason: Current datasets do not provide a global refugees-per-degree relationship.

gaps.missing: Model-derived annual temperature, forcing, and sea-level series for selected IAM/GCM ensemble members.
gaps.reason: IPCC Table SPM.1 provides 20-year means; linear interpolation would fabricate annual data.

gaps.missing: A documented reduced-complexity climate model or emulator with gas-specific lifetimes, forcing, feedbacks, aerosols, and uncertainty.
gaps.reason: CO2-equivalent emissions cannot be treated as atmospheric CO2 or a temperature prediction.

gaps.missing: Locally acquired NASA SSH indicator time series.
gaps.reason: Metadata are verified, but download requires an Earthdata-authenticated step.

gaps.missing: No defensible universal coefficients for hurricanes counted, food security, freshwater stock loss, or refugees per degree.
gaps.reason: These outcomes are multivariate, regional, definition-sensitive, and scenario-conditioned.
